component: Calendar attachment icon query and receiver contract

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original item appends ?size directly to each moz-icon source, including a source that can already contain query text. Its test only exercises a query-free dummy source. Accepted code delegates to makeMozIconSrcSet, whose query helper chooses & for an existing query and whose output escapes srcset separators. Keep this later repair separate from the original URI utility and item tests; no rendered icon failure was reproduced.
title: The original Calendar icon srcset appends another query delimiter
